exposure: standardized transverse diameter of intestinal gas (STDI) on plain X-ray images
cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) infants with meconium ileus (MI) hospitalized in two tertiary centers between 2011 and 2022.
finding: The study developed a novel prediction model using the standardized transverse diameter of intestinal gas (STDI) from daily X-ray images to predict intestinal perforation in very low birth weight infants with meconium ileus.
followup_time: 5 days of age (for X-ray assessments and perforation outcome)
